filingBasics.noteZh: 数量对应该通知/报告版本，不是品牌总规划；频段和轨道参数为已取得文件范围，不能跨行相加。

filingBasics.noteZh: 2,692 是状态表网络通知数量；报告部分频段的通知分母为 720，不能把整个网络总量直接当作所有 Ka 频段的履约分母。父网络最早申报日不替代各频率组计时。
filingBasics.noteEn: 2,692 is the status-table network count; some reported bands have a 720 notified denominator. Do not apply the network total to all Ka-band compliance ratios. Parent receipt does not replace frequency-group clocks.

filingBasics.noteZh: 此行对应 125500033 通知摘要。MIFR 为网络关联通知的汇总状态；存在 PART II-S 及其他指配的 PART III-S，不能视为全部频段无条件获准。
filingBasics.noteEn: This row covers notification 125500033. MIFR is a related-notice aggregate; PART II-S and PART III-S for other assignments do not imply unconditional approval of all bands.

filingBasics.noteZh: 协调通知 120520170 的公开摘要；当前修改收件为 2024-07-17，不替代原频率组时钟。最早监管期限为网络汇总，2025 API 新频段不能直接套用。

filingBasics.noteEn: Public coordination-version summary is 1,728, not Guowang’s overall 12,992 target. Notification 125500219 is under examination; unconfirmed BIU does not mean the physical fleet has not launched.

filingBasics.noteZh: ITU 公开摘要确认 96,714 颗；关联 API 与协调通知不相加。组织字段空白，不能归入国网或千帆。轨道跨度含非低轨部分。

filingBasics.noteZh: ITU 公开摘要确认 96,714 颗；不是获批建设总量。组织字段空白，不能归入国网或千帆；关联空间站数不代表已部署卫星数。
filingBasics.noteEn: ITU public summary confirms 96,714, not an authorized build-out. Organization field is blank; not assigned to Guowang/Qianfan. Associated space-station records are not deployed-satellite counts.
